facts.text: Check-in is from 3:00 PM. Check-out is by 11:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability.
There is an outdoor swimming pool open daily 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM, free for guests. Towels are provided.
Breakfast is included in Deluxe and Family Suite rates. For Standard rooms it is optional at ₹1,200 per person. Served 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM.
Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Within 48 hours, the first night is charged. No-shows are charged the full stay.
Free high-speed WiFi is available throughout the property.
On-site parking costs ₹800 per night. EV charging is not available.
Pets are not allowed, except registered service animals.
The fitness centre is open 24 hours for guests.
The airport is 25 minutes away. A paid shuttle can be booked at the front desk for ₹2,500.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: 1 king bed plus sofa bed, lake view, 35 sqm, breakfast included.

rooms.name: Family Suite
rooms.description: 2 bedrooms, living area, lake view, 60 sqm, breakfast included.
